verdicts.reason: Both candidates have the same failure. The wind-turbine icon and the red, green and blue triangles are shrunk into a thumbnail-sized strip on the left that you can't read, so the original's key imagery and its framing triangles are effectively gone. The headline is pushed hard against the right edge and is far too big for the layout, and stray diagonal lines float across a large empty lower half. The only differences are where the text and lines sit vertically, which doesn't make either one better.
